entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]受到自省症状的困扰，躯体渐渐衰弱。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is hindered by debilitating bouts of introspection.

entries.zh: 该单元执行过多缓慢且纠结细节的自我诊断。
entries.en: This unit performs many slow, detail-oriented self-diagnoses.

entries.zh: 该节点信息处理效率低下，面对外星物种时难以提供有效的见解。
entries.en: This node is inefficient at data processing, and struggles to provide useful insight when dealing with alien species.

entries.zh: 该单元在信息处理方面效率低下，在开展外交事务时常常崩溃。
entries.en: This unit is inefficient at data processing, and often crashes when attempting to provide diplomatic insight.

entries.zh: 该节点天性多疑，并向其他[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]传播其对于异种的猜疑。
entries.en: This node is naturally suspicious, spreading its distrust of aliens among other [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 该单元的信任协议出现错误，导致其多疑的特性。
entries.en: This unit contains faulty trust protocols resulting in heightened skepticism.

entries.zh: 该节点的基因中充斥着攻击与暴力。
entries.en: This node has a genetic predisposition towards aggression and violence.

entries.zh: 该单元喜怒无常，程序常常出现不稳定的情况。
entries.en: This unit is temperamental and prone to bouts of volatility.

entries.zh: 该节点显得不是很愿意主动发起行动。
entries.en: This node shows a reluctance to act proactively.

entries.zh: 该单元看上去好像不能主动做出反应。
entries.en: This unit displays an inability to respond proactively.

entries.zh: 该节点借助有益共生体的化学分泌促进[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]的健康。
entries.en: Through the chemical secretions of a mutualistic symbiont, this node promotes well-being within the [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].

entries.zh: 为[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]准备新星球是一项危险且代价高昂的任务，但该[owner.GetIndividualName]知道如何化解这些风险。
entries.en: Preparing new worlds for the [owner.GetGestaltEntityName] is dangerous and costly. This [owner.GetIndividualName] knows how to mitigate those risks.

entries.zh: 将新星球整合进网络是一项危险且代价高昂的任务，但该单元安装的程序可以化解这些风险。
entries.en: Integrating new worlds into the network is dangerous and costly. This unit is programmed to mitigate such risks.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]是专门为了帮助那些在生产过程中需要指导的个体而选育的。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] was selectively bred to guide those who require assistance in the production process.

entries.zh: 该单元有能力分离并删除那些低效的生产模式。
entries.en: This unit is equipped to isolate and delete inefficient production patterns.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]适于同步管理多项任务。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is suited to manage several demanding tasks simultaneously.

entries.zh: 在这个单元的支援方程的帮助下研究子个体的工作速度显著提升了。
entries.en: Research units work significantly faster with the help of this unit's support equations.

entries.zh: 该节点擅长以辩证的言语吸引智慧生物。
entries.en: This node is incredibly adept at enthralling intelligent beings with its dialectic eloquence.

entries.zh: 言简意赅，以有机体的风格开展交流，该单元极为擅长参与外交会议。
entries.en: Concise and thoughtful with organic communication styles, this unit excels at diplomatic meetings.

entries.zh: 该节点能够持续不断地分泌出某种化学信息素，进而确保同类[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]们突触的正确发育。
entries.en: This node emits a constant chemical signal which reinforces the correct synapse development in its fellow [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 在此单元的监管下，像是文件损坏、数据丢失以及类似的故障不太可能发生。
entries.en: Corrupt files, data loss, and similar code failings are less likely to occur under this node's guidance.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]特别热衷于培育后代。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is especially keen on nurturing offspring.

entries.zh: 在生产新机器的时候，可以在对应的环节采用恰当的代码来优化生产。
entries.en: with the right code in the right place, production of new machines can be optimized.

entries.zh: 借助高度专业分化的肢体，该[owner.GetIndividualName]能够轻松开采行星地层中的资源。
entries.en: With specialized fossorial limbs, this [owner.GetIndividualName] can easily access subterranean planetary resources.

entries.zh: 借助高级动力钻头，该单元能够轻松开采行星地层中的资源。
entries.en: Equipped with advanced power drills, this unit can easily access subterranean planetary resources.

entries.zh: 优先考虑宜居性的问题后，即使是恶劣的环境最终也能变得对[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]有益。
entries.en: By prioritizing adaptability, hostile environments can become beneficial to the [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].

entries.zh: 对现存生物群落的保护使得可持续开发成为可能。
entries.en: The preservation of existing biomes allows for sustainable exploitation.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]是专门为适应并理解异星的文化而选育的。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] was selectively bred to be adaptive and understanding towards alien cultures.

entries.zh: 该单元是专门为开展同化进程、维护良好的通信架构而设计的。
entries.en: This unit specializes in supporting unification processes and maintaining positive communications.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]在监管产业的过程中无视危险副产品的堆积。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] ignores the buildup of dangerous by-products from the industries it oversees.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]在生理上通过感受疼痛的刺激作为满足的手段。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is physically reliant on pain-receptor stimulation as a means of fulfillment.

entries.zh: 这个单元在功能上依赖于通过频繁的损伤传感器来达到刺激。
entries.en: This unit is functionally reliant on frequent damage-sensor stimulation.

entries.zh: 一种厌恶一切冲突的天性驱使该[owner.GetIndividualName]拒绝所有可能的军备升级。
entries.en: A natural aversion to conflict drives this [owner.GetIndividualName] to avoid possible military escalation.

entries.zh: 该单元提倡和平并尝试拒绝所有增加战斗准备度的企图。
entries.en: This unit promotes peace and will attempt to reject all attempts at increasing combat readiness.

entries.en: This unit focuses on archaeological missions.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]具有超强传感器，可以在调查星系物体时发现最深层的矿藏。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] has been granted extra-powerful scanners to find even the deepest deposits when surveying.

entries.zh: 该单元具有强劲传感器，可以在调查星系物体时发现最深层的矿藏。
entries.en: This unit has in-built scanners to find even the deepest deposits when surveying.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]与其它的协作者们产生了深厚的连接，行动一致如同一体。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] has a deep connection with its peers; they move together as if one being.

entries.zh: 该单元与其他合作的单元私下维系着一个通信网络，提高彼此间的合作效率。
entries.en: This unit keeps a private network with its support units, enhancing their combined functions.

entries.zh: 进攻就是最好的防御。进攻者以无情和攻击性著名，能够在对方做出反制之前歼灭敌人的舰队。
entries.en: Offense is the best defense. Aggressors are known for their relentless attacks, annihilating enemy fleets before they can counter.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]特别狡猾。他的战术旨在削弱敌人的力量，智胜对手的指挥官。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is especially cunning. Their tactics are designed to mitigate enemy strengths and outsmart their commanders.

entries.zh: 战略家有更优越的大局观。比起在前线拼杀，他们更擅长于维系全军的团结，制定星系级的战争计划。
entries.en: Strategists are focused on the bigger picture. Instead of leading the battle up front, they prefer to maintain cohesion in the military and draw galaxy-spanning war plans.

entries.zh: 该单元内置程序将谨慎操作设定为最高优先度。
entries.en: This unit has been programmed to prioritize caution.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]怀有保护自己疆域的坚定信念。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] possesses an unrelenting desire to defend its home territory.

entries.zh: 该单元者正警觉地保护着领土。
entries.en: This unit serves as a vigilant guardian for claimed territory.

entries.zh: 该单元没有安装投降协议。
entries.en: This unit does not possess a surrender protocol.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]拥有一项特殊能力，能够在脑海中构思出所有舰队的补给需求。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] possesses the unique ability to conceptualize the logistical needs of entire fleets.

entries.zh: 该单元能够计算所有舰队的补给需求。
entries.en: This unit is capable of processing the logistical needs of entire fleets.

entries.zh: 经过多代仔细的基因筛选，该[owner.GetIndividualName]已经能够对给定目标造成巨额伤害。
entries.en: Generations of careful gene selection have produced a [owner.GetIndividualName] that is capable of inflicting massive damage on a given target.

entries.zh: 在绕过内置的安全协议后，该单元极大地提高了武器的攻击效率。
entries.en: Through bypassing safety protocols, this unit can increase weapon efficiency to a tremendous degree.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]将展示自身力量、部署侵略行动作为自己的基本战术。
entries.en: Shows of force and well-timed acts of quasi-aggression are typical of this [owner.GetIndividualName]'s tactics.

entries.zh: 对威胁构建的完美计算构成了该单元作战策略的基础。
entries.en: Perfectly calculated threats of violence form the basis of this unit's engagement strategy.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]是集体意识至上权威的物理化身。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is the physical embodiment of the collective's authority.

entries.zh: 该单元的操作协议被看作是最高性能的标准范例。
entries.en: This unit's operational protocols serve as a constant exemplar of peak performance.

entries.zh: 对于该[owner.GetIndividualName]来说，外交策略和其他形式的冲突一样重要。
entries.en: To this [owner.GetIndividualName], diplomacy is as important as any other form of conflict.
The most efficient victories are won without violence.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]完全不顾忌它麾下的个体
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] has no regard for those under its command.

entries.zh: 该单元在战斗中不会将其麾下的战斗单位的战损状况纳入计算范畴。
entries.en: The calculations of this unit do not include the wellbeing of the units it commands.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]从[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]中获取物资供其自己使用。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] takes supplies from the [owner.GetGestaltEntityName] for its individual use.

entries.zh: 这个单元的错误程序导致了反常行为的发生。
entries.en: This unit's faulty code leads to deviant behavior.
This [owner.GetIndividualName] spreads its deviancy to others.

entries.zh: 这个单元可以将反常度向周围传播。
entries.en: This unit spreads its deviancy to others.

entries.zh: 该节点可以运用多种工具增强我们的渗透能力。
entries.en: This node possesses several tools to enhance our infiltration capacity.
